spss:
tit S8-S9.
compute s8flag=0.
if miss(s8_1) or ~range(s8_1,0,s7_2) s8flag=1.
if miss(s8_2) or ~range(s8_2,0,s7_2) s8flag=1.
if sum(s8_1,s8_2)<>s7_2 s8flag=1.
exe.
temporary.
sel if s8flag=1.
list respid s8flag s7_2 s8_1 s8_2.
del var s8flag.
compute s9sum=sum(s9_1,s9_2,s9_3,s9_4,s9_98).
temporary.
sel if miss(s9_1) or miss(s9_2) or miss(s9_3) or miss(s9_4) or miss(s9_98) or ~range(s9sum,0,s8_1) or s9sum<>s8_1.
list respid s7_2 s8_1 s9_1 s9_2 s9_3 s9_4 s9_98 s9sum.
del var s9sum.
exe.
warnings: The questionnaire requires S9 to sum to S8_1; the supplied dictionary confirms numeric fields but does not encode the specialty-specific termination rules.
